mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (platform, bot_id, group_id, user_id, platform_name, call_name, activity_level, interest_tags, familiarity, affinity, interact_digest) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, #{platformName}, #{callName}, #{activityLevel}, #{interestTags}, #{familiarity}, #{affinity}, #{interactDigest}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE platform_name = COALESCE (VALUES (platform_name), platform_name), call_name = COALESCE (VALUES (call_name), call_name), activity_level = COALESCE (VALUES (activity_level), activity_level), interest_tags = COALESCE (VALUES (interest_tags), interest_tags), interact_digest = COALESCE (VALUES (interact_digest), interact_digest), familiarity = GREATEST(familiarity, VALUES (familiarity)), affinity = VALUES (affinity)
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, user_id AS userId, platform_name AS platformName, call_name AS callName, activity_level AS activityLevel, interest_tags AS interestTags, familiarity, affinity, interact_digest AS interactDigest, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_profile WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, user_id AS userId, platform_name AS platformName, call_name AS callName, activity_level AS activityLevel, interest_tags AS interestTags, familiarity, affinity, interact_digest AS interactDigest, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_profile WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (platform, bot_id, group_id, user_id, platform_name, familiarity, affinity) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, #{platformName}, GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, #{familiarityDelta})), GREATEST(-100, LEAST(100, #{affinityDelta}))) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE platform_name = COALESCE (#{platformName}, platform_name), familiarity = GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, familiarity + #{familiarityDelta})), affinity = GREATEST(-100, LEAST(100, affinity + #{affinityDelta}))
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profile SET call_name = COALESCE(#{callName}, call_name), interest_tags = COALESCE(#{interestTags}, interest_tags), interact_digest = COALESCE(#{interactDigest}, interact_digest), activity_level = COALESCE(#{activityLevel}, activity_level), affinity = COALESCE(#{affinity}, affinity) WHERE id = #{id}
